jobs.title: Hardware Engineering Program Manager
jobs.description:
THE COMPANY

PAX is a leading global cannabis brand on a mission to enhance people’s lives, delivering well-being through pure products, unique experiences, and an unparalleled passion for the plant. For more than a decade, PAX has provided products that are simple, enjoyable, and trusted by millions. PAX has been recognized for its brand, culture and products by The New York Times’ Wirecutter, TIME, Fast Company, GQ, Gear Patrol, mg Magazine, High Times, and many more. PAX is committed to making a positive impact through PEACE BY PAX, its purpose-driven platform supporting social reform, safe access and sustainability.

We are incredibly excited about the progress of the movement, the tremendous growth of the industry, and inspired every day by our opportunity to help change lives through cannabis. Our culture is focused on putting people at the center of everything we do, making an impact together, and having fun along the way. Our team has an unparalleled passion for the plant and has helped build business at the forefront of consumer experience and well-being, including Apple, Google, Uber, Fitbit, Constellation, Honest Company, Beauty Counter, Eaze, Curaleaf, Wyld and more. PAX has raised over $430MM in capital from leading consumer and technology investors and is available for sale in some capacity in more than 40 countries around the world.

ROLE AND RESPONSIBILITIES

Reporting directly to the Director of Product Development, PAX is looking for an Engineering Program Manager (EPM) responsible for design, development, and support of PAX hardware products.

PAX EPMs are responsible for managing and communicating project definition, development milestones, project schedules, validation/FA/CA, and project status in the development of new products. This role will immediately manage a high volume hardware program and be responsible for driving and establishing processes and best practices for engineering product development. This role will be a key gap-filler in the organization to ensure every aspect of our hardware team is running smoothly with great program management hygiene. As a PAX EPM, you will:

- Drive process development, improvements, and best practices consistent with a world class hardware product development organization.

- Own and oversee program schedules and NPI build phase gates, while ensuring high risk areas have mitigation strategies and actions in place.

- Mediate between hardware and the rest of the PAX organization. Collaborate closely with Engineering, PLM, Operations and Product to execute on HW programs through DVT and ensure a smooth transition to Operations at PVT.

- Drive strong program management hygiene including project meeting cadence, bug / action item tracking, and engagement with external design and manufacturing partners.

- Create clear and consistent presentations to executive leadership on project status and schedules.

- Travel to support manufacturing builds and ensure factory engagement best practices are established.

PERSONAL AND PROFESSIONAL QUALIFICATIONS:

- 4 to 8 years of direct experience managing development programs.

- Experience with Jira, Smartsheet, or other program management software.

- Experience engaging both internal engineering teams and external suppliers.

- Excellent organizational, communication, presentation, and data analytics skills.

- Ability to focus on details and a resourcefulness to drive issues until they are resolved.

- BS in Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, related discipline, or demonstrated experience.

- Domestic and International travel is expected - up to 25%.

- Three days a week on-site at PAX’s office in San Francisco required

- Have an interest in cannabis.

- PMP is a plus, but not a requirement.

EDUCATION:

- BS in Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, related discipline, or demonstrated experience.

THE IDEAL CANDIDATE WILL:

- Operate with high autonomy, directly owning full program schedules and acting as the central hub between technical and operational teams

- Track record of taking at least one program from concept to production

- Owns and oversees program schedules and NPI build phase gates, ensuring high-risk areas have mitigation strategies in place

- Collaborates closely with Engineering, PLM, Operations, and Product to execute on HW programs through DVT and ensure a smooth transition to Operations at PVT

- Direct experience as a hardware engineer (electrical, mechanical, or embedded/firmware) is desired to easily understand a wide variety of technical issues

- Previous experience with medical devices or other regulated products is desired

PAX PERKS & BENEFITS

- Competitive compensation, equity & bi-annual performance reviews

- Fully funded comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage

- 401K plan

- Generous PTO policy

- Paid Parental Leave

- Monthly wellness reimbursement

- Cell Phone reimbursement

- Employee Purchase Program for discounted PAX devices

- Weekly catered lunch, endless snacks and beverages

- Dog Friendly HQ in the Mission District of San Francisco

- Employee Assistance Program including access to online legal support

COMPENSATION

In addition to the benefits above, this role has a pay range between $125,000-$185,000 + equity. This pay range represents what we believe, in good faith, this role will pay. The final pay will depend on many factors, including years and depth of experience, level, and location of the employee. We only expect to pay the top of the range in rare and exceptional circumstances, for candidates that far exceed the requirements and expectations of the position.

PAX VALUES

Put Consumers First - We are here to enhance their lives. We put their needs first in everything we do. We work together to deliver unique solutions for their benefit.

Build a Community - We are active and beneficial builders of a global community. We collaborate together to support sustainability, well-being and social equity efforts—both internally and externally—to establish cannabis as a force for good.

Innovate with Passion - We are passionate about enhancing the cannabis experience by making it positive, accessible and intuitive. We set the standards, innovate for consumers and find the yes as a team.

Be the Solution and Collaborate - We work as a team to achieve winning outcomes, knowing we each individually are the solution, but can only succeed together.

Lead with Humility and Transparency - We stay open and humble in everything we do. We value learning from each other, and cultivate transparency in our culture and products.

We will ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions, and to receive other benefits and privileges of employment. Please contact us to request accommodation.

jobs.title: Field Marketing Manager
jobs.description:
ABOUT PAX

PAX is a leading global cannabis brand redefining how people experience the plant through thoughtful design, innovative technology, and a commitment to quality. PAX has built a brand at the intersection of cannabis, design, technology, and culture. We are driven by the belief that cannabis can make life better and that innovation can unlock its benefits in ways that set a higher standard for the category.

THE OPPORTUNITY

PAX is seeking a Field Marketing Manager to bring our brand and products to life in New Jersey, with a particular focus on licensed dispensaries and priority retail partners. This person will turn national brand and product strategies into locally relevant programs that drive awareness, education, trial, and sell-through. They will work closely with Sales, Trade Marketing, Brand, Creative, and retail partners to ensure PAX shows up consistently and compellingly wherever consumers encounter us.

The ideal candidate understands both brands and retail. They can build a thoughtful market plan, establish strong relationships with dispensaries and field teams, and personally ensure that an activation is executed beautifully. They are comfortable spending significant time in market and know how to turn field observations into actionable business insights.

ROLE AND RESPONSIBILITIES

Elevate the Retail Experience

- Own how PAX shows up across dispensaries, including merchandising, product visibility, displays, fixtures, signage, POS materials, and other in-store touchpoints.

- Build a regular market visitation cadence, audit execution, and work directly with retail partners to resolve gaps.

- Partner with Sales to prioritize accounts and deploy field resources where they can have the greatest impact on awareness, velocity, and sell-through.

- Support product launches, promotions, and priority campaigns with consistent retail execution.

- Monitor competitive activity and retail trends, translating field observations into recommendations for Sales and Marketing.

Lead the Field Team

- Own the PAX Brand Ambassador program, including recruiting, onboarding, training, scheduling, and ongoing management.

- Set clear brand standards for how ambassadors represent PAX with consumers, budtenders, and retail partners.

- Equip the field team with the product knowledge, tools, talking points, and materials needed to educate consumers and drive conversion.

- Build efficient market coverage plans based on account priorities, sales opportunities, launches, and local events.

- Establish KPIs and track activity, execution quality, and impact.

Build Retail Advocacy

- Build strong relationships with budtenders, store managers, and other influential retail partners.

- Develop an ongoing budtender engagement strategy spanning product education, training, incentives, sampling or gifting, and relationship-building.

- Create scalable training programs while maintaining the high-touch approach that matters in dispensary retail.

- Gather feedback on products, consumer behavior, competitive activity, and barriers to sell-through.

Bring PAX to Life

- Develop and execute a market-level activation strategy spanning retail pop-ups, vendor days, consumer events, community partnerships, and sponsorships.

- Own activation execution from planning through wrap-up, including staffing, logistics, vendors, materials, product, compliance, and the on-site brand experience.

- Translate national campaigns and product launches into locally relevant experiences.

- Build repeatable activation playbooks and evaluate programs based on participation, engagement, sales impact, and other relevant KPIs.

HOW YOU'LL WORK

- Build genuine relationships and represent PAX with credibility and professionalism.

- Bring strong operational discipline to fast-moving, highly visible work.

- Stay flexible when conditions change and solve problems calmly in the moment.

- Balance premium brand standards with the realities of retail execution.

- Communicate clearly and keep cross-functional partners informed.

- Operate with energy, resourcefulness, high ownership, and low ego.

- Spend approximately 60 to 70% of your time in market.

QUALIFICATIONS

- 5 to 7+ years of experience in field, retail, or experiential marketing for a consumer brand.

- Demonstrated success planning and executing retail programs, activations, and events.

- Strong relationship-building skills across sales, retail, vendors, and external partners.

- Excellent project management skills, with attention to timelines, logistics, and budgets.

- Experience gathering market feedback and translating it into useful business insights.

- Strong written, verbal, and presentation skills.

- Comfort working independently and spending significant time in market, including occasional evenings, weekends, and travel.

- Experience in cannabis, CPG, beverage alcohol, consumer electronics, wellness, or another regulated consumer category is strongly preferred.

- Familiarity with licensed retailers, cannabis consumers, and state-specific compliance.

- Genuine enthusiasm for cannabis and creating exceptional consumer experiences.

COMPENSATION

The anticipated base salary range for this role is $80,000 to $110,000, plus equity, benefits, and mileage reimbursement. Actual compensation will be determined based on relevant experience, skills, location, and other job-related factors.

PAX is an equal opportunity employer. Applicants are considered for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, disability, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law. PAX complies with applicable fair-chance and pay-transparency requirements.

Please note this job description is not designed to cover or contain a comprehensive listing of activities, duties, or responsibilities required of the employee. Duties, responsibilities, and activities may change at any time with or without notice.
